g.text: Mixed service through restriction, outage and recovery
Independent 200 + 200 Mbps links · 3 TCP + 1 QUIC · 70/30 ms · 40 s offered load
Shading is nominal probe time: QUIC forward rate 10 Mbps at 15–25 s; UDP blackhole at 30–33 s. UP mirrors impairment.
Actual shaper samples retain their own clock in the data. UP is sink-confirmation arrival, not instantaneous target-write service.
One observation per version; no smoothing or variability bands. Defaults: prior 10%/10%; candidate 20%/20%.
Echo markers above the axis: × failed attempt, | unavailable; neither is a latency value. Exact samples/outcomes accompany the SVGs.
